explanation_short: XGBoost outperforms other models in terms of error metrics (MAE, RMSE, MAPE).
explanation_full: Comparing the error metrics (MAE, RMSE, MAPE), XGBoost consistently achieves the lowest values across the board (e.g., MAE 0.88, RMSE 1.05, MAPE 8.8%). This consistent minimization of prediction errors is the key indicator of its superior predictive accuracy.
